claims.quote: Forensics pried free a false rear shelf and photographed it; a technician eased a gloved finger into the gap and, after a careful shot, showed me the pictures. The images, and what the tech described, made the rest plain: a shallow cavity sat behind the shelf, the exact dimensions a small revolver's grip would have occupied.
claims.value: hidden shallow cavity behind false rear shelf sized to hold a small revolver

claims.quote: Photographs showed the revolver seated on a thin brass shim, its gilding marked with clock oil, a neat curled shaving of brass beside it where the shim had been trimmed.
claims.value: found inside obj-longcase-clock hidden cavity on trimmed brass shim

claims.quote: Photographs showed the revolver seated on a thin brass shim, its gilding marked with clock oil, a neat curled shaving of brass beside it where the shim had been trimmed.
claims.value: gilding flecked with clock oil; seated on trimmed brass shim; scrap of brass present

claims.quote: The waxed black thread that had been threaded into the movement ran into that cavity and was fastened to a small bent bracket on the gun's trigger-guard.
claims.value: thread run into movement and attached to bent bracket fastened to trigger-guard of gun

claims.quote: The scores and hairline scrapes around the access panel suggested the bracket had been fitted and the work concealed.
claims.value: bent bracket affixed inside cavity to gun's trigger-guard; hairline scrape and scores suggest recent fitting

claims.quote: Putting those pieces together suggested the mechanism. The clock's strike train would deliver a reliable tug at a set minute; the thread, fixed to the bracket, would pull the trigger. The revolver, bedded on the trimmed shim, could discharge toward the blotter. The shim's trimmed edge and the cavity's profile, as seen in the photographs, were consistent with a rebound that allowed the barrel to slip partly back into the hollow; a small notch or catch beneath the barrel could then take a rim as the case settled, leaving the access panel to sit crooked as if latched from inside.
claims.value: clock strike train tugged thread at set minute to pull trigger; rebound and shim profile consistent with barrel slipping back and catch seating to allow panel to appear latched

claims.quote: Thomas, who'd serviced the clock, rubbed his thumb and forefinger the way he always did and said the thing I'd already been given to expect: "I didn't kill him, Ellis. I was there days ago to service the clock, but I left before eleven."
claims.value: "I didn't kill him, Ellis. I was there days ago to service the clock, but I left before eleven."

claims.quote: The torn scrap in Lucius's hand, on inspection, had the look of being placed afterward — fibres lying on top of the knuckles, no transfer staining.
claims.value: torn note had been placed on victim's hand after death; fibres and lack of transfer consistent with staging

claims.quote: The typed envelope on the desk bore the blunt warning about the ivory; forensics had lifted a partial print from the flap's diagonal crease that they described as consistent with Iris Harben.
claims.value: partial latent print lifted from flap described by forensics as consistent with Iris Harben

promises.promise: Discover the whereabouts of the missing cameo watch from Mrs. Harben's mother's display and determine its relation to Iris Harben's motive.
promises.quote: One thing remained off the table — a small cameo watch from Mrs. Harben's mother's display, missing when I asked about it. It wasn't where she'd said it would be.
